 Crystal Palace travel to the Tupras Stadyumu in Istanbul to face Besiktas in the UEFA Europa League. Pierre Sage's side make the trip to Turkey looking to arrest a difficult run of form in continental competition. 
 Besiktas enter this fixture under Vincenzo Italiano having shown they are capable of producing results in Europe. The Turkish club beat Hoffenheim 2-3 away from home in the Europa League last month, and earlier dispatched Marseille 4-1 in the group stage, demonstrating real attacking threat on the continental stage. 
 Crystal Palace arrive in Istanbul under pressure. Sage's side were beaten 5-0 by Brighton in the Premier League and then lost 3-2 to Lyon in their previous Europa League outing, leaving them in a precarious position in the competition's standings. 
 Besiktas, for their part, come into this match on the back of a 2-0 Super Lig defeat to Trabzonspor, a result that will have stung ahead of a fixture they will view as an opportunity to restore confidence on home soil. 
 In the Europa League table, Besiktas sit in fourth place while Palace find themselves in 15th, meaning the Eagles desperately need a result to keep their European campaign alive.

 Watching on your phone or laptop is fine, but live sports belongs on the big screen. Here is how to get the VPN working on your TV:
